title: Tuning NiCu/AlO(OH) catalysts for optimal glycerol hydrogenolysis to 1,2-propanediol
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4252-4274
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07593A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Asma Ghorbani, Ajay K. Dalai
Through systematic tuning of Ni–Cu composition and operating conditions on AlO(OH), this study demonstrates a balanced catalyst design that achieves high activity, selectivity, and stability for efficient glycerol hydrogenolysis to 1,2-propanediol.
